name: Collect-A-Con San Francisco
blurb: Bay Area stop of the multi-city Collect-A-Con tour: trading cards, pop-culture collectibles, cosplay and celebrity autograph signings at the San Mateo Event Center.
notes: collectaconusa.com/san-francisco/ reads 'The First Collect-A-Con San Francisco!' with a 'get notified when details are available' signup and no explicit date, alongside Panel/Celebrity Schedule assets uploaded Aug 2026, suggesting that first show already ran. The official 'San Francisco 2026 Recap' page ('Thank you for attending! See you next year.') confirms that edition concluded, but neither page restates its exact dates in the rendered text. No next San Francisco/San Mateo date is published anywhere on the site, so editions is left empty. Re-checked 2026-10-05: exact dates now confirmed via the con's own 'BUY TICKETS' link target, its Universe.com event listing (rendered fresh), which reads 'Collect-A-Con (San Francisco, CA) Sat, Sep 12, 2026 - Sun, Sep 13, 2026 ... 2495 S. Delaware St, San Mateo, CA 94403' and 'Sales Ended' -- added as 'last' (San Mateo Event Center is a multi-address fairgrounds complex; this gate address and the site's own '1346 Saratoga Dr' both refer to the same venue).
